course_info.trial_description:
1. Introduction: The trial lesson aims to introduce my students to the learning process while also allowing me to assess their language proficiency, goals and preferences. The focus will be on creating an interactive and engaging environment where the student feels comfortable practising and speaking.

2. The lesson structure (10-15 minutes): We will begin with a friendly introduction while I ask about the student's background, motivation for learning, and language goals. I use this opportunity to understand my student's current level to establish whether they're beginners or more advanced.

Language Focus (10-15 minutes)
English Beginners: We'll cover basic conversational topics such as (greetings, self-introduction, and everyday activities).
English Advanced Learners: We'll focus on more complex structures, vocabulary and grammar practice.
Zulu Beginners: We'll introduce common greetings and basic phrases.
Zulu Advanced Students: We may explore sentence construction, verb tenses and cultural expressions unique Zulu.

3. Interactive Task (10-15 minutes) : To make the learning  process hands-on, we'll engage  in a task that reflects real-life scenarios:
English : 
A role-playing activity (e.g.ordering food, making a phone call ) or a small reading comprehension exercise.
Zulu:
We'll do practical role-playing tasks like role-playing introductions, shopping, or understanding simple Zulu stories.

4. Assessing Needs & Learning Style (5-10 minutes)
After the task, so future lessons can be adapted accordingly, we'll reflect on what the student found easy or challenging. I'll ask about your preferred learning style, whether it is visual or audio, or whether you learn more when you are engaged in activities,  instead, rather than listening or watching.

5. Goal Setting & Conclusions (5 minutes) At the end of the trial, we'll set clear, achievable goals, whether it's expanding vocabulary, improving speaking fluency or mastering grammar & answering your questions.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Classes: Personalized Structured Sessions and Free Talk Exploration for Adult Learners Seeking Fluency, Correction, Vocabulary and Confidence!
pro_course_detail.description:
In my general conversation classes, I aim to create a dynamic and personalized learning experience tailored to your preferences and goals. Each session begins with a check-in to understand how you're feeling and how I can best support your learning journey. This initial discussion allows you to express any specific requests or questions you may have, ensuring our time together is productive and focused.

I offer two main types of classes:

Structured Classes:
If you prefer a more structured approach, you can request that I guide the conversation with specific questions or topics of interest to you. Prior to the class, please message me with your preferences so I can prepare relevant vocabulary and conversation starters. I can suggest typical topics for discussion, but I encourage you to share any specific ideas or requests you have in mind. This approach helps maintain focus and allows us to delve deeper into areas that interest you the most.

Free Talk Classes:
For those who enjoy a more flexible and spontaneous approach, my free talk classes provide an open platform where we can discuss virtually any topic of your choice. Many of my students in free talk classes see me not just as a teacher but as a conversational partner and friend. You are welcome to bring up any specific subjects you wish to practice or explore. If you prefer, we can bypass basic introductions and dive straight into engaging discussions.

Please Note:
In both structured and free talk classes, I actively participate by typing corrections and feedback in the chat while we converse. My role is to facilitate your speaking practice, ask relevant questions, and offer language corrections to help improve your fluency and accuracy.

Additional Information:
My classes are designed for adult learners and are not suitable for children or elementary-level students.

pro_course_detail.description:
If you're looking for personalized lessons tailored to your specific interests or language needs, this lesson is for you. Before booking, please send me a message so we can discuss what you want to focus on. I’ll customize the lesson to suit your preferences, whether it's exploring a particular subject or improving your language skills in a specific area.

I offer lessons on a variety of topics, including:

Social and Cultural Topics: Explore subjects like anthropology, cultural diversity, traditions, celebrations around the world, gender roles, and indigenous practices. I can guide you through meaningful discussions and provide vocabulary-building exercises to enhance your understanding.
